route_title: Periodic ZnS/ZnSe Quarter-Wave Stack for MWIR Suppression with LWIR Pass
compilation_rationale: Fixed 16-layer alternating ZnSe/ZnS stack on Ge substrate. Optimized for broadband IR transmission while suppressing shortwave infrared. Initial thickness assumes quarter-wave at 7000 nm; bounds expanded to 1000–10000 nm to capture wideband phase compensation. Registry-resolved dispersion models applied. Normal incidence simulated coherently via smatrix solver.
